I'll think this through like I do every spring when I sit down with my wife to plan the year.

**My reasoning:**

I farm 50 mu — that's a decent size for our village, bigger than most. Seven mouths to feed, so I can't afford a bad year. I finished middle school, so I read the fertilizer bags and I talk to the agro-shop owner in town, but mostly I farm the way my father did and I adjust when I see something work for my neighbors.

My main land is the wheat-maize rotation — about 30 mu. This is my bread and butter. Wheat in October, maize right after harvest in June. For wheat I use an improved variety, something like Jimai 22 or whatever the dealer pushes that year — my neighbors all switched years ago and the yield is better than the old seed. I put down compound fertilizer (15-15-15) as base, about 50 kg per mu, then topdress urea at returning green — maybe 20 kg per mu. That gives me roughly 20 kg N per mu total. I irrigate 3 times with the well: once before winter, once at jointing, once at filling. I expect 450 kg per mu in a normal year.

For maize I plant Zhengdan 958 or Xianyu 335 — hybrid, everyone uses hybrid now, you can't buy the old seed anymore. I put a bag of compound at sowing and topdress urea at big flare stage. Irrigation 2 times is usually enough since summer rain helps. I get around 550 kg per mu.

The other 20 mu I split for cash crops — this is where the real money is for a family of 7. Garlic 5 mu (autumn planted, harvest in May — Quzhou garlic sells well), chili 3 mu, cabbage 3 mu, onion 2 mu, and 7 mu stevia because the company has a contract in our county and the price is stable. Vegetables need more fertilizer and more water, but also more pesticide — chili especially, aphids and anthracnose every year. I spray 5-6 times on chili, 3-4 on cabbage.

I plough the wheat field every 2-3 years to break the hard layer, otherwise rotary tillage — cheaper and faster when hiring the machine. Vegetables I always plough deep, they need loose soil.

I'd rather spend 50 yuan more on fertilizer than lose 200 yuan of yield. Pesticide I'm more careful — too much and the vegetables won't sell.
